$comment: High/critical dependency advisories that are accepted, with the reason they are not reachable and the date the waiver must be re-justified. scripts/ci/audit-dependencies.mjs fails on an advisory that is not listed here, on an entry that no longer applies, and on an entry past its expires date. This list may only shrink.

image-size|GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq.reason: Build-time only: image-size is reached solely through metro (the React Native bundler) when Expo assembles apps/carer and apps/elder. It parses the repository's own static image assets, never user uploads, and never runs in the Next.js server or in a shipped app binary. metro pins image-size@^1.2.1 and image-size 2.x made imageSize() asynchronous, so a major override would break the bundler. Revisit when metro ships an ^2 range.

image-size|GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr.reason: Same package and same build-time reasoning as GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq; a separate advisory against the ICNS parser.

zod|GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5.reason: Build-time only: zod 3.x is reached solely through @expo/cli, which validates expo config at build time. The advisory is memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections; the collection sizes come from this repository's own app.json, not from user input. @expo/cli declares zod ^3 and zod 4 changes the error/parse API, so pushing 4.x into the CLI is a bundler break, not a fix. Revisit when @expo/cli supports zod 4.
